title: Native host: make `ObjectStackNative.platform` an open set and pin it with an App-level test (follow-up to #29140)
body:
## Context

objectstack-ai/objectstack#29140 (card #29039) merged the Console's shell mode. An acceptance review checked it against the shell (objectstack-ai/mobile `main` 8c6f13a). The bridge contract matches item by item: the global, event name, methods, haptic kinds, argument shapes, push token, errors and events.

One acceptance item, from a maintainer comment on #29039, is met at runtime but has no test, and the type contradicts it: **the platform is an open set**. The desktop shell will report a value other than `ios` or `android`.

- **Runtime:** `getNativeHost` has no platform check, the root attribute takes the value verbatim, and wrappers gate on `has()` only (`ui/packages/mobile/src/nativeHost.ts:109-123`, `ui/apps/console/src/App.tsx:160-164`).
- **Type:** `readonly platform: 'ios' | 'android'` (`nativeHost.ts:65`) is a closed union. A consumer can write an exhaustive `never` switch that silently misses `desktop`.
- **Tests:** both fake bridges hard-code `ios`/`android` (`nativeHost.test.tsx:53`, `App.nativeShellMode-29039.test.tsx:105`), and both announce every capability (`has: () => true`).

## Ask

1. **Widen the type** to `'ios' | 'android' | (string & {})`. Update the README and changeset wording (`data-os-native-shell="ios|android"`).
2. **Add an App-level test** with `platform: 'desktop'` and a subset of capabilities. Assert that:
   - shell mode is on;
   - `ready` is posted once;
   - the root attribute is `desktop`;
   - a method that is not announced is never called.
3. **Settle what `ready` means.** Today `ready()` fires at the first commit of the router tree (`App.tsx:244-245`). On a cold start to a protected route, that commit is `AuthGuard`'s loading fallback (`ProtectedRoute.tsx:55-61`). Either:
   - document `ready` as "the Console has painted its own UI, possibly a loading fallback", or
   - post it after `AuthGuard` settles.

   Say which in the PR. The shell will start relying on `ready` in objectstack-ai/mobile#162.
4. **Version gate.** Nothing reads `ObjectStackNative.version`. Treat a host with `version > 1` as no shell (a safe browser fallback), or record why not.
5. **README nit.** `ui/packages/mobile/README.md:314` changes button text on host presence (`host ? 'Save' : 'Save changes'`), which breaks the "viewport and capability, not host" rule. Use a capability check or drop the branch.

## Acceptance

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mobile test` and the console test pass, including the new desktop/subset case.
- The type change compiles across `ui/` with no new casts.
